items.what: buildZip() writes 0 into every central-directory entry’s "relative offset of local header" field (deck-core.mjs: centralHeader.writeUInt32LE(0, 42)), so all 21 entries claim offset 0. Any reader that resolves entries by that offset decompresses garbage.
items.workaroundHere: Entries are walked sequentially from byte 0 in local-header order and matched to the central directory by name, with CRC-32 recomputed for every entry.
items.userImpact: Microsoft PowerPoint / LibreOffice generally locate parts through the OPC relationships and open this file, but zip-level utilities that trust the offset may fail. Worth reporting upstream.

items.what: renderHtmlSlide() ignores the bullets array for layout "cover" (deck-core.mjs: the cover case emits only kicker, title, subtitle, meta), while the manifest still writes those bullets. A deck whose cover carries bullets therefore loses them in the HTML while the manifest claims they are there.
items.workaroundHere: All five slides use the points layout, and the verifier now asserts that every manifest title and bullet really appears in both the HTML and the PPTX slide XML.
